# Hermes Agent: Onboarding FAQ & Troubleshooting Guide

Welcome to Hermes Agent. This guide answers common questions and troubleshooting scenarios across installation, model configuration, messaging gateways, agent features, and plugin extensibility.

---

## 1. General Setup & Platform Support

### How do I access the Web UI dashboard?
Run `hermes dashboard`. This launches a local web server at `http://127.0.0.1:9119` and opens your browser. It includes a **Chat** tab embedding the full terminal interface.

### Is native Windows supported?
Yes. Windows 10/11 is a Tier 1 supported platform using the official PowerShell installer (`install.ps1`). 
*Note:* The Web Dashboard `/chat` embedded terminal requires a POSIX PTY; use WSL2 if you require that specific web-terminal pane.

### Can I run Hermes on ARM64 / Raspberry Pi / Apple Silicon Docker?
Yes. Official Docker images (`nousresearch/hermes-agent:latest`) publish multi-arch manifests supporting both `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.

### How do I fix `[Errno 13] Permission denied` on NAS Docker bind mounts (UGOS, Synology, unRAID)?
Set the `PUID` and `PGID` environment variables (e.g., `PUID=1000`, `PGID=10`) in your Docker container. Hermes remaps runtime permissions to match your host UID/GID.

### Can Hermes run on Android via Termux?
Yes. The installer (`scripts/install.sh`) automatically detects Termux, sets proper temp directories (`TMPDIR`), and installs the curated `termux-all` dependency group.

---

## 2. Models, Providers & Authentication

### Why are small local models (Qwen 4B/9B, Ollama) very slow?
Hermes sends its full tool schema (~45 tools) on every API turn, creating large input prompt overhead that strains small models. To optimize:
- Disable unused tools: run `hermes tools`.
- Set `terminal.backend: local` in `~/.hermes/config.yaml` to remove container overhead.
- Use faster quantizations or upgrade to 32B+ models for tool-heavy workflows.

### Why is Ollama/Localhost routing to Anthropic or giving HTTP 401 errors?
If `provider: auto` is set, Hermes scans environment variables for API keys and may default to Anthropic. In `~/.hermes/config.yaml`, explicitly set `provider: custom` with your local `base_url`:
```yaml
model:
  default: ollama/your-model
  provider: custom
  base_url: http://localhost:11434
fallback_providers: []
```

### How do I connect to Ollama Cloud?
Select or configure the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider. Ollama Cloud uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint `https://ollama.com/v1` (not `/api`).

### How do I enable vision on custom or local Ollama endpoints?
Add `supports_vision: true` to your custom model configuration in `config.yaml`.

### Why does Claude bill API tokens instead of using my Pro/Max plan?
Anthropic bills all direct API key access per-token. To use Claude Pro/Max subscription allowances, authenticate via OAuth rather than an API key.

### Does Hermes support Azure AI Foundry?
Yes. Run `hermes setup` (which auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`) or set `provider: azure-foundry` in `config.yaml`. Claude Code-specific env variables are not required.

### How do I use Google Gemini?
Google Gemini CLI OAuth was removed because Google restricts third-party OAuth inference. Use Google AI Studio by exporting `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

### Does Hermes support automatic cheap-model routing (`smart_model_routing`)?
No. Automatic per-turn complexity routing was removed by design policy. To switch models manually, use `/model` or `hermes chat -m <model>`. For subagents, configure `delegation.provider` and `delegation.model`.

### How does token usage tracking work for local OpenAI-compatible providers (LocalAI)?
Hermes automatically sends `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` on streaming requests to capture token counts for `/usage`.

---

## 3. Gateways & Messaging Platforms

### Why do I get "Unauthorized user" on Telegram DMs?
`allowed_chats` is only for whitelisting group chats. To authorize individual DM users, use one of these options:
1. **Allowlist User ID:** Add to `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:
   ```yaml
   telegram:
     allow_from: "YOUR_TELEGRAM_USER_ID"
   ```
2. **Pairing Code:** DM the bot, then run `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>` on the host.
3. **Allow All:** Set `allow_all: true` under `telegram:` in `config.yaml`.

### How do I set up Discord without manual file editing?
Run the interactive setup wizard:
```bash
hermes gateway setup
```
Select Discord and follow the prompts to enter bot tokens and allowed user IDs.

### Can the agent send and receive files/images across gateways?
- **Inbound:** Uploaded text files and code (`.py`, `.txt`, etc.) are automatically read and injected into context.
- **Outbound:** Hermes natively delivers generated documents and attachments via Matrix (`m.file`), Email (SMTP multipart), Telegram, and Discord.
- **DingTalk:** Supports remote images rendered via Markdown image syntax (`![image](url)`).
- **MCP Images:** Base64 image outputs from MCP tools are tagged (`MEDIA:<path>`) and forwarded as native platform images.

### How do per-channel personas work?
Use `channel_prompts` in your gateway configuration to assign custom system prompts to specific channel or group IDs on Discord, Telegram, Slack, and Mattermost.

### Can one gateway serve multiple user accounts/profiles?
Yes. Multi-profile multiplexing (`gateway/run.py`) enables a single gateway process to manage multiple platform adapters (e.g., Weixin, Telegram) scoped to individual user profiles, keeping memory, skills, and sessions isolated.

### Why do Telegram sessions reset after restarts?
Hermes uses `resume_pending` state to preserve transcripts across crashes and restarts. If an interruption occurs, use `/resume` to restore history. Automatic idle resets default to `mode: none`.

---

## 4. Agent Execution, Autonomy & Memory

### What is the tool-call limit and how do I run long autonomous tasks?
Turns default to `agent.max_turns: 90` (override via `--max-turns <N>`). When the turn limit is reached, tool calling pauses. For persistent, multi-turn tasks:
- Start a goal using `/goal <task description>`.
- If paused by iteration budgets, resume with `/goal resume`.

### How does multi-agent communication work?
The agent uses the `delegate_task` tool to spawn isolated child subagents with independent context, toolsets, and terminal sessions, supporting up to 3 concurrent tasks by default.

### What are `SOUL.md`, `USER.md`, and `MEMORY.md`?
- **`~/.hermes/SOUL.md`**: Defines the agent's core persona and behavior instructions.
- **`~/.hermes/USER.md`**: Stores persistent user profile information and preferences (targeted via `target="user"` in memory tools).
- **`~/.hermes/MEMORY.md`**: General agent memory and knowledge storage.
- *Local Honcho note:* Honcho memory works without an API key for `localhost` / `127.0.0.1` endpoints.

### How does Hermes prevent context overflow from tool outputs?
Hermes includes a built-in `ContextCompressor` (implementing the `ContextEngine` interface) that automatically deduplicates and compacts older verbose tool outputs while keeping recent token history intact.

---

## 5. Extensibility, Observability & Maintenance

### How do I create and enable custom tools?
Do not edit core files. Create a plugin in `~/.hermes/plugins/`, register your tool using `ctx.register_tool(...)`, and activate it:
```bash
hermes plugins enable <plugin-name>
```
*Note:* In-tree memory additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed; create memory providers as standalone plugins implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC.

### How do I track tool call traces (Langfuse)?
Enable the bundled Langfuse observability plugin:
```bash
hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse
```

### How do I check skill usage statistics?
View execution statistics via `/insights` in chat or by running `hermes insights`. Skill usage counts and timestamps are tracked in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`.

### Why does `hermes update` stall on Node.js dependencies?
The update process runs a post-install hook for Camofox browser binaries, which downloads assets without progress indicators. Let it finish.

### How do I report security vulnerabilities?
Do not open public GitHub issues. Submit reports via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/new) or email `security@nousresearch.com`.
